prose:
Stratechery’s weekly overview lists bundle content and includes a sponsored OpenRouter passage about customers using more model families. The retrieved page is a roundup and advertisement rather than the full analysis of the linked episodes.

The usage claim is limited to the sponsor’s described customer segment, not every AI user or the whole market. No substantive conclusion about the listed political, leadership or device discussions can be inferred without their source articles or transcripts.
highlights: Page is a weekly bundle overview
Customer spending threshold limits the cited population
Provider-family count differs from market share
Linked episode arguments were not available
